note: Thresholds and limits for the cleanup agent. Kept in configuration so a run can be tuned without editing code.
minimum_occurrences_reason: support 0.005 x 17,796 transactions = 89; a candidate below this cannot enter any rule, so asking a model about it buys nothing

confidence.note: at or above apply the decision is used as is; between apply_with_flag and apply it is used but marked low_confidence; below apply_with_flag it becomes needs_review
